tasks.label: Read-only local environment configuration check
args: const fs=require("node:fs");const path="server/.env";if(!fs.existsSync(path)){console.log("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: MISSING");console.log("PORT: MISSING");console.log("CORS_ORIGINS: MISSING");process.exit(0)}const values={};for(const line of fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8").split(/\r?\n/)){const match=/^(?:export\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$/.exec(line);if(match)values[match[1]]=match[2].trim()}console.log("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: "+(values.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=== "wellexsa"?"PASS":"FAIL"));console.log("PORT: "+(values.PORT=== "3001"?"PASS":"FAIL"));const origins=(values.CORS_ORIGINS||"").split(",").map(v=>v.trim());console.log("CORS_ORIGINS: "+(origins.includes("http://localhost:5500")&&origins.includes("http://127.0.0.1:5500")?"PASS":"FAIL"));
